schema.name: ap_deliveries_object_id
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX ap_deliveries_object_id ON ap_deliveries (object_id, attempted_at)

schema.name: ap_inbox_activity_id
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ap_inbox_activity_id ON ap_inbox (activity_id)

schema.name: comments_author
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX comments_author ON comments (author_name, author_email, status)

schema.name: comments_slug
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX comments_slug ON comments (slug, submitted_at)

schema.name: comments_status
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX comments_status ON comments (status, submitted_at)

schema.name: users_username
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_username ON users (username)

schema.name: actor_keys
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE actor_keys (
        identifier  TEXT NOT NULL,
        algorithm   TEXT NOT NULL,
        private_jwk TEXT NOT NULL,
        public_jwk  TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (identifier, algorithm)
      )

schema.name: actor_profiles
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE actor_profiles (
        actor_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        handle     TEXT,
        name       TEXT,
        icon_url   TEXT,
        url        TEXT,
        fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

schema.name: admin_migrations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE admin_migrations (
      version    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      applied_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

schema.name: ap_deliveries
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE "ap_deliveries" (
        activity_id   TEXT NOT NULL,
        activity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        object_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
        slug          TEXT,
        actor_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
        inbox_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
        status        TEXT NOT NULL,
        error         TEXT,
        attempted_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (activity_id, actor_id)
      )

schema.name: ap_inbox
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE ap_inbox (
        id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        activity_id   TEXT,
        activity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        actor_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
        object_id     TEXT,
        received_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
        json          TEXT NOT NULL
      , in_reply_to TEXT, recipient TEXT, reply_key TEXT, fetched INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

schema.name: ap_relays
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE ap_relays (
        inbox_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        actor_id   TEXT,
        state      TEXT NOT NULL,
        reason     TEXT,
        follow_id  TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

schema.name: cms_state
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE cms_state (
        key        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value      TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

schema.name: comments
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE comments (
        id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        slug         TEXT NOT NULL,
        permalink    TEXT NOT NULL,
        source       TEXT NOT NULL,
        kind         TEXT NOT NULL,
        status       TEXT NOT NULL,
        author_name  TEXT NOT NULL,
        author_url   TEXT,
        author_email TEXT,
        markdown     TEXT NOT NULL,
        html         TEXT NOT NULL,
        submitted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        address_hash TEXT,
        in_reply_to  TEXT
      , url TEXT, author_avatar TEXT, notify INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, redacted TEXT, rsvp TEXT, via TEXT, migrated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, origin TEXT, user TEXT, actor TEXT)

schema.name: followers
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE followers (
        username        TEXT NOT NULL,
        actor_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
        inbox_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
        shared_inbox_id TEXT,
        handle          TEXT,
        name            TEXT,
        icon_url        TEXT,
        url             TEXT,
        followed_at     TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (username, actor_id)
      )

schema.name: password_resets
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE password_resets (
        token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

schema.name: sessions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE "sessions" (
        id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        user_id    INTEGER,
        csrf_token TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        flash      TEXT
      )

schema.name: settings
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE settings (
        key        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value      TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

schema.name: spent_tokens
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE spent_tokens (
        token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        spent_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
        expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

schema.name: users
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
        id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        username      TEXT NOT NULL,
        password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at    TEXT NOT NULL
      )

schema.name: webmentions_sent
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE webmentions_sent (
        slug         TEXT NOT NULL,
        source       TEXT NOT NULL,
        target       TEXT NOT NULL,
        endpoint     TEXT,
        status       TEXT NOT NULL,
        error        TEXT,
        attempted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (slug, target)
      )
